rows.title: PANDA - "Here We Learn Ways of Coping"

content.title: PANDA - "Here We Learn Ways of Coping"
content.who: PANDA for Children: children in grades 2-6 who have difficulty regulating their emotions because of emotional overload, attention difficulties, anxiety or social difficulties. PANDA for Parents (DBT skills): parents of children of all ages. PANDA in the Family: families with at least 2 children.
content.what: A group program for strengthening emotion regulation and developing coping skills, combining mindfulness and cognitive-behavioral techniques with play. PANDA for Children: 8 sessions for children and 3 sessions for parents. PANDA for Parents: 8 sessions (or 6). PANDA in the Family: usually 6 family sessions and 6 parent guidance sessions.
content.process: You fill out a questionnaire and a participation request, have an introductory conversation with a facilitator, and are placed in a group according to age.

rows.title: NAMAL - Let's Make Room for Play

content.title: NAMAL - Let's Make Room for Play
content.who: Parent-toddler pairs exposed to stress, crisis or trauma, as well as pairs dealing with difficulties typical of this age.
content.what: A play group for parents and toddlers with play, music, art, drama and movement activities, plus parent-only sessions. 8 sessions, once a week, 16:30-18:00.
content.location: Metiv Children, Givat Shaul, Herzog Medical Center Clinics Building, Jerusalem
